description: Geoscience Australia - Major Aviation Terminals 2012 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. This dataset presents locations of major aviation terminals in Australia. The major aviation terminals dataset was digitized in 2012 from aerial photography, orthophotos and satellite imagery held within Geoscience Australia. The primary information source used to identify and attribute the dataset was the Airservices Australia website supplemented with individual airport websites. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. Its tags are built, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
